decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed two storey side and single storey rear extension  because of its position, design and appearance would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 24 Unwin Road and is complimentary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with the adopted UDP policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development),  H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003 and Supplementary Planning Guidance, "Residential Extension Guidelines".
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northwest and southeast walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a 2 storey side and single storey rear extension to existing house.
